findings.criterion: A1/F17, E1/E2: validate every effective input and preserve report/tree alignment before direct, legacy or delta arithmetic.
findings.title: The final ingress check precedes a mutable report hook, allowing malformed trees and observable report/tree reassociation to reach aggregation.
findings.cause: Schema and original-object position checks finish at lines207-221. client_selection_strategy.on_reports_received then receives mutable self.updates and context at line226. There is no corresponding validation after that hook and before aggregation dispatch at lines235-237. Payload trees shared by updates and weights_received can change, and the report list can reorder independently of the effective tree list.

reproduction.setup: Actual native LeNet, Algorithm, Server and FedAvg strategy; valid float32 client trees and 8/24 sample counts pass earlier preflight. The late selector hook changes client 2 fc3.bias from shape(10,) to broadcastable shape(1,). Both arrival orders exercised.
reproduction.observed: Direct and legacy dispatch both perform weighted arithmetic without rejection and load ten 3.25 values. Delta dispatch revalidates and rejects before arithmetic with global parameters unchanged.

reproduction.setup: Same-schema bias arrays 1 and 4, sample counts 8/24. The late selector hook reverses the update/report list while weights_received remains in its original positional order.
reproduction.observed: Direct, legacy and delta dispatch all accept the observable reassociation and load approximately 1.75 instead of the independently expected 3.25.

findings.impact: F17 remains bypassable on the supported extension boundary. Result/load validation cannot recover original malformed shapes after broadcasting, and schema validation alone cannot detect report/tree pairing changes.
findings.requested_change: Preserve the captured owned baseline and earlier raw/weights hook checks. After on_reports_received, immediately before dispatch, validate effective eligible trees and sample/count contracts and reject observable report/tree reassociation. Include late-selector shape/count/order negative regressions for direct/legacy/delta, both arrival orders and zero-weight eligible inputs. Unlabeled deep-copy replacements should retain the accepted positional contract.
findings.acceptance_after_repair: Both reviewer probes must reject before aggregation arithmetic or global load, with the global model unchanged; existing valid independently trained 8/24 results and native/affected tests must continue to pass. Require a fresh identity-bound independent review.
